text:
Aisha (Billing): Heads-up — customer 'aurora-ai' flagged a billing spike on invoice 3312: +2.4M tokens vs expected for Mar 22. Numbers don't align with their ingest logs.
Jonah (Platform): do we have an initial diff table?
Aisha (Billing): internal metering shows two clusters of token totals for the same message ids during 01:40-01:55 UTC. Looks like duplicates at the aggregator layer.
Mei (SRE): checking infra — there was an edge-aggregator failover at 01:48 and we saw a replay window open. Could be double-processing of in-flight batches.
Priya (Finance): estimate impact -> ~2.4M tokens ~= $144. Need a quick triage to decide credit vs backfill.
Jonah (Platform): SQL I ran to surface duplicates:
```
select msg_id, count(*) as ct, sum(tokens) as tokens
from metered_events
where stream='aurora-ai' and ts between '2026-03-22T01:35:00Z' and '2026-03-22T01:58:00Z'
group by msg_id
having count(*) > 1
order by tokens desc
limit 20;
```
Mei (SRE): results show ~1.1k msg_ids duplicated; avg token per msg ~2200. Matches ~2.4M. Edge log snippet: `2026-03-22T01:48:02Z aggregator-02 failover; replay-mode=soft; ack_forwarded_twice=true`.
metering-bot: auto-detect -> duplicate-message-burst stream=aurora-ai window=2026-03-22T01:35:00Z-2026-03-22T01:58:00Z duplicate_count=1103 duplicate_tokens=2398600 ticket=INC-2026-211.
Aisha (Billing): I propose provisional credit for $150 while Platform runs a deterministic de-dupe reprocess. Approve?
Priya (Finance): provisional credit OK. Please attach audit CSV of msg_ids before applying.
Jonah (Platform): will run a backfill job with idempotent keys, estimate 3-4 hours; will post final delta and a patch to the aggregator to prevent double forwards.
Aisha (Billing): created BILL-ADJ-599 and linked INC-2026-211. Marking invoice 3312 as provisional credit applied.
Mei (SRE): after reprocess we'll validate counts against aurora's ingest logs.
Priya (Finance): thanks — keep updates here. If reprocess doesn't reconcile, credit stands.
